# Arya Suneesh — Full Profile

## Identity

- **Name:** Arya Suneesh
- **Website:** https://aryasuneesh.github.io/
- **Email:** aryasuneesh3@gmail.com
- **Location:** India
- **Education:** B.Tech, IIIT Kottayam

## Current Role

**NLP Engineer, TIFIN RM** (January 2025 – Present)
- Led production deployment of a semantic caching system using MPNet embeddings, achieving >40% latency reduction for financial advisors
- Spearheaded expansion of TIFIN RM's NLP capabilities to cover alternative investments (hedge funds, private equity)
- Developed intent recognition and entity recognition systems for financial query understanding
- Resolved critical production issues and optimized response generators through prompt engineering

## Research Experience

**MCQST Summer Bachelor Program** — Munich Center for Quantum Science and Technology, LMU Munich (July–August 2025)
- Selected as 1 of 16 participants worldwide
- Implemented Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) for SU(2) Yang-Mills gauge theory on superconducting quantum hardware at Walther-Meißner-Institut
- Designed a 4-qubit architecture with post-selection and symmetry-based error correction

**DAAD WISE Scholar** — Berlin University of the Arts & Einstein Center for Digital Future (May–July 2024)
- Selected as 1 of 250 DAAD WISE recipients worldwide
- Built speech recognition models (DeepSpeech, Whisper) for the Reading Primer digital education device
- Developed adaptive NLP and ASR systems optimized for Raspberry Pi hardware for child literacy

## Publications

1. **TIFIN at CheckThat! 2025: Reasoning-Guided Claim Normalization for Noisy Multilingual Social Media Posts**
   - Authors: Manan Sharma, Arya Suneesh, et al.
   - Venue: CLEF 2025 Working Notes, CEUR-WS Vol. 4038
   - Key result: 41.3% relative improvement in METEOR over baseline; 3rd rank on English leaderboard
   - URL: https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4038/paper_95.pdf

2. **TIFIN India at SemEval-2025: Harnessing Translation to Overcome Multilingual IR Challenges in Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval**
   - Authors: Prasanna Devadiga, Arya Suneesh, et al.
   - Venue: SemEval-2025, Proceedings of NAACL 2025
   - Key result: success@10 of 0.938 (monolingual), 0.810 (crosslingual)
   - URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.16627

3. **TIFIN at CheckThat! 2025: Cross-Lingual Subjectivity Classification in News**
   - Authors: Kishan Gurumurthy, Arya Suneesh, et al.
   - Venue: CLEF 2025 Working Notes, CEUR-WS Vol. 4038
   - URL: https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4038/paper_72.pdf
